verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace driven by its CLI, API, SDK and agents, so asking whether it can version, review and roll back automations is a fair question. The evidence pack shows no first-party versioning, change review or rollback for automations, jobs or templates. Pod volume backups and restores only protect stored data, an adjacent capability that does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
